title: Juicy Turkish Chicken Stir-fry
description: Mustardy, tender stir‑fry with pickle‑juice glaze, perfect for meal‑prep and high‑protein Turkish flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok over medium‑high heat until shimmering.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger, sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Toss in the diced chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook until the edges start to brown, about 4–5 minutes.
Stir in the sliced onion, bell pepper, and zucchini, cooking for another 3 minutes until vegetables are crisp‑tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together pickle juice, Dijon mustard, and soy sauce until smooth.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and vegetables, stirring to coat evenly and simmer for 2–3 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Remove from heat, taste and adjust seasoning if needed, and let the stir‑fry rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Divide the dish into four airtight containers for meal prep, storing in the fridge for up to 4 days.
